import socket,sys,time
for i in range(60):
    try:
        s=socket.create_connection(('127.0.0.1',6665),timeout=1)
        s.settimeout(2)
        data=s.recv(4096)
        print(data.decode('utf-8','ignore'))
        s.close()
        sys.exit(0)
    except Exception:
        time.sleep(1)
print('PROBE_FAILED')
sys.exit(1)
